planned.prompt: Now I'm adding a subnet in network and putting app's servers in it. app needs the subnet's id. Can that go in one change?
planned.reply: The id doesn't exist until the subnet is created, so app's plan can't know it. Planned one estate at a time, app would wait for network, plan again and need a second approval. Planned together, one apply creates the subnet first and hands its id to app.

planned.prompt: Show me everything that depends on the new subnet.
planned.reply: {dependents} resources depend on it, in app and edge.

approved.action: You approve the plan on the pull request.

applied.reply: Applied. The subnet's id went from network to app to edge in one apply.

applied.prompt: Did the apply lock anything while it ran?
applied.reply: Resource-level locking at the cloud level: each resource's record is written only if it's unchanged since it was read, so nothing is ever left locked.

closing: One record store for every estate. One plan, one apply, across estates.
